official_download_verification.comparison: Fresh HTTPS download hashed locally; no claim of publisher-signature verification

static_analysis.limitations: Application-owned sources inspected statically. Linux target not executed. Dependencies and remote service not proven safe. Raw evidence excluded from public repository because it contains workstation paths.

ports.macos: Electron shell with Mac-specific integration and dependency security update; see locked version
ports.ios: Native Swift/WKWebView wrapper with capability-limited compatibility bridge
ports.windows: Shared Electron shell and bridge from macos/, cross-packaged for Windows x64 with local addons; community NSIS installer and portable ZIP.
ports.linux: Shared Electron shell and bridge from macos/, rebuilt for Linux x64 with local addons; AppImage and tarball.
ports.android: Native Java/Android WebView wrapper with origin-scoped main-frame messaging and capability-limited compatibility bridge.

signing.ios: unsigned device binary and simulator build; no embedded signing identity
signing.windows: No Authenticode certificate; unsigned community executable and installer.
signing.linux: No publisher signature; release SHA-256 checksums and pinned AppImage runtime.
signing.android: Self-signed persistent local project distribution certificate; private key excluded; certificate fingerprint in android/reports/verification.json.
